svg.text: 11 Apply labels and record the build.
A1 prototype • CAD renders • not a fabrication release • 2026-10-24
Apply the A1 label master. J1 is the
supply input; output terminals are load
Verify +24 V and 0 V/GND (−) against J1
pin numbers. There is no protective-earth
Record printer settings, screw fit, switch
alignment. Update CAD under a new revision
Electrical operation requires the staged bring-up procedure and an A1 firmware port. Test the actual terminal behavior, switch cycling and temperatures;
a lit PWR LED does not prove execution.
